DF_PARTICLE_EFFECTS.TypeHint: Visual fire, ice, smoke, ground cracks, viscous liquid or restraints (web, vines, rope, chains, serpent) clipped to this region. It does not deal damage or change tokens.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.hint: Turn this effect on or off without deleting the behavior. The region's own Disabled checkbox also hides it. While this window is open, the map previews your changes. Close it without saving and the preview goes away.

effectType.label: Effect Type
effectType.hint: None keeps the settings but draws nothing. Fire, Ice, Smoke / Fog, Ground Cracks, Viscous Surface and Restraint / Binding show only the fields they use.

fireStyle.label: Fire Style
fireStyle.hint: Area Fire is irregular burning ground across the whole region and uses Arrangement, Density, Ember Amount and Edge Fade. Ball Of Fire is one radial fireball centered on the region; it uses Flame Scale (size), Flame Speed and Opacity.

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.hint: Single flame stacks sprites into one fire at the region center. Field draws one continuous top-down fire surface across the region (legacy sprite Field remains available in module settings).

density.label: Density
density.hint: For Field (shader): how much of the region burns versus floor gaps. For Field (legacy): how many flame sites per grid cells. 0 hides Field fire. Single flame ignores density.

flameScale.label: Flame Scale
flameScale.hint: For Field (shader): size of flame structures in the noise field. For Single / legacy Field: size of each flame sprite relative to the scene grid.

flameSpeed.label: Flame Speed
flameSpeed.hint: How fast the fire surface, flicker, and rising embers move.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.hint: Overall opacity of the effect. Keep this below 1 so the map stays visible.

emberAmount.label: Ember Amount
emberAmount.hint: Sparse rising sparks over the fire. For Field (shader) this scales with region size; for legacy Field it scales with flame sites. 0 disables sparks.

edgeFade.label: Edge Fade
edgeFade.hint: 0 keeps a hard edge. Higher values fade legacy flame bases and ember origins near the boundary. The region mask always clips the fire, including holes.

freezeMode.label: Freeze Mode
freezeMode.hint: Freeze once: the surface freezes over when the behavior is created or enabled, then stays frozen (after a reload it is already frozen). Already frozen: no animation. Loop: freeze, hold, start over.

freezeDuration.label: Freeze Duration
freezeDuration.hint: Seconds from clear ground to a fully frozen surface.

holdTime.label: Hold Time
holdTime.hint: Loop only: seconds the surface stays fully frozen before it starts over.

loopReset.label: Loop Reset
loopReset.hint: Loop only: how the ice clears before it freezes again. Thaw retreats toward the region edges; Fade dissolves the whole surface.

edgeBias.label: Edge Bias
edgeBias.hint: How strongly the ice grows in from the region edge (and from holes). 0 freezes in patches across the whole region.

crystalSize.label: Crystal Size
crystalSize.hint: Size of ice plates, cracks and frost veins relative to the scene grid.

refraction.label: Refraction
refraction.hint: How much the scene background is distorted and blurred under the ice. Only the background image is refracted, not tiles or drawings. Without a background image the ice is a translucent tint.

smokeColor.label: Smoke Color
smokeColor.hint: Grey for smoke, white for fog, green for poison gas, near-black for soot.

smokeDensity.label: Smoke Density
smokeDensity.hint: Low values leave loose patches with gaps; high values close into a solid blanket.

smokeScale.label: Cloud Size
smokeScale.hint: Size of the billows relative to the scene grid.

driftSpeed.label: Drift Speed
driftSpeed.hint: How fast the smoke drifts and churns. 0 keeps it almost still.

driftDirection.label: Drift Direction
driftDirection.hint: Direction the smoke moves, in degrees: 0 up, 90 right, 180 down, 270 left.

edgeSoftness.label: Edge Softness
edgeSoftness.hint: Grid cells over which the smoke thins out toward the region edge. 0 keeps a hard edge.

crackMode.label: Break Mode
crackMode.hint: Break open once: the ground cracks open when the behavior is created or enabled, then stays broken (after a reload it is already broken). Already broken: no animation. Loop: break open, hold, start over.

crackDuration.label: Break Duration
crackDuration.hint: Seconds from whole ground to fully opened cracks.

crackHold.label: Hold Time
crackHold.hint: Loop only: seconds the cracks stay open before it starts over.

crackReset.label: Loop Reset
crackReset.hint: Loop only: how the cracks clear before the ground breaks again. Close pulls them back toward the middle; Fade dissolves them.

crackOrigin.label: Crack Origin
crackOrigin.hint: Epicenter opens a pit in the region middle with fissures running outward, and the cracks travel from the middle to the edge. Scattered breaks the ground open in patches.

crackScale.label: Plate Size
crackScale.hint: Size of the broken ground plates relative to the scene grid.

crackWidth.label: Crack Width
crackWidth.hint: How wide the cracks open. It also scales how far the plates shift.

glowColor.label: Glow Color
glowColor.hint: Color shining out of the cracks: orange for magma, blue or green for magic, purple for void.

glowStrength.label: Glow Strength
glowStrength.hint: How strongly the cracks glow. 0 leaves plain dark cracks in the earth.

shake.label: Shake
shake.hint: How hard the ground shakes while it breaks open. The shake stops shortly after the cracks are fully open.

dust.label: Dust
dust.hint: Dust thrown up from fresh cracks while they open. 0 disables it.

liquidStyle.label: Surface Style
liquidStyle.hint: Tar / Oil: very dark, slow and heavy with a few big bubbles and an oily sheen. Lava: glowing seams between dark crust plates. Acid: toxic yellow-green, slightly clear, bubbling and faintly glowing. Slime / Goo: translucent, thick and strongly distorting with big bubbles. Arcane Goo: vivid soft color gradients, slow flow, strong refraction and gloss. The sliders below adjust the style.

liquidFlow.label: Flow Speed
liquidFlow.hint: Percent of the style's flow tempo. 100 is the style default.

liquidViscosity.label: Viscosity
liquidViscosity.hint: Percent of the style's thickness. Higher values make bigger, smoother and slower swells.

liquidBubbles.label: Bubble Amount
liquidBubbles.hint: Percent of the style's bubbles. 0 disables them.

liquidGlow.label: Glow Strength
liquidGlow.hint: Percent of the light the liquid gives off. 0 turns the glow off.

liquidDistortion.label: Distortion
liquidDistortion.hint: Percent of how strongly the scene background is bent under the liquid. Only the background image is distorted, not tiles or drawings.

liquidCrust.label: Edge Crust
liquidCrust.hint: Percent of the crust or foam band along the region edge. 0 removes it.

liquidCustomColor.label: Custom Color
liquidCustomColor.hint: Off uses the style's own colors. On tints the liquid with the color below; for Lava it colors the glow.

liquidColor.label: Color
liquidColor.hint: Color of the liquid when Custom Color is on.

restraintStyle.label: Style
restraintStyle.hint: Web is a spider web over the whole region. Vines, Rope, Chains and Serpent are strands that lie in the region and move.

restraintCustomColor.label: Custom Color
restraintCustomColor.hint: Off uses the style's own color (silk white, green-brown vines, hemp rope, iron chains, dark green serpent). On uses the color below.

restraintColor.label: Color
restraintColor.hint: Color of the web, vines, rope, chains or serpent when Custom Color is on.

restraintAnimation.label: Animation Amount
restraintAnimation.hint: How much it moves. 0 holds it still. Vines stay subtle even at 100.

restraintThickness.label: Thickness
restraintThickness.hint: Thread or strand thickness. 1 is the style default.

restraintDensity.label: Coverage / Density
restraintDensity.hint: Web: how complete the web is (lower tears out threads). Vines: how many vine bundles grow.

webRadials.label: Radial Threads
webRadials.hint: Number of threads running out from the hub.

webRings.label: Circular Threads
webRings.hint: Turns of the capture spiral between the hub and the edge.

vineVariation.label: Organic Variation
vineVariation.hint: How much the vines wander and wobble.

vineTwist.label: Twist Amount
vineTwist.hint: How tightly the vines of a bundle wind around each other.

vineThorns.label: Thorniness
vineThorns.hint: Share of thorns along the vines. 0 gives smooth roots.

strandCount.label: Count
strandCount.hint: Number of ropes or chains (1 to 5).

strandLayout.label: Layout
strandLayout.hint: Straight and Curved run across the region, Coiled lies in loops, Random wanders.

strandMotion.label: Motion
strandMotion.hint: Static lies still. Writhe moves on its own. Extend shoots out once when the effect appears. Retract pulls back and comes out again. Tighten pulls taut to bind and slackens again.

chainWeight.label: Heaviness
chainWeight.hint: Heavier chains react slower and move more deliberately.

serpentMotion.label: Motion
serpentMotion.hint: Slither glides through the region along a winding track. Coil lies coiled and breathes slowly.

serpentScales.label: Scale Visibility
serpentScales.hint: How clearly the scales and their shading show.

randomSeed.label: Random Seed
randomSeed.hint: Leave empty or 0 to keep a stable layout derived from this scene, region, and behavior. Any other number reshuffles only this fire.

quality.name: Fire quality
quality.hint: Caps legacy flames and embers per region and per scene. Shader surfaces are not affected. The saved region settings do not change.

fieldRenderer.name: Field fire renderer
fieldRenderer.hint: Shader draws one continuous top-down fire surface (recommended). Legacy keeps the old multi-campfire sprite Field for comparison. Arrangement Single is unchanged.
